name: basic-filter help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:basic-filter. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Remove rule
entries.text: Removes rule. Depending on your behaviour theme it asks first. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Add rule
entries.text: Adds rule. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Open sort & filter
entries.text: Opens sort & filter. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Basic filter
entries.text: Shows the “Basic filter” part of this screen. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Sort & filter
entries.text: Sorts & filter. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Column
entries.text: Where you set “Column”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Condition
entries.text: Where you set “Condition”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: To
entries.text: Where you set “To”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Attach it
entries.text: Attaches it. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: All rules
entries.text: Shows the “All rules” part of this screen. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Any rule
entries.text: Shows the “Any rule” part of this screen. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Z → A
entries.text: Shows the “Z → A” part of this screen. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Remove sort key
entries.text: Removes sort key. Depending on your behaviour theme it asks first. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Add sort level
entries.text: Adds sort level. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Attach by dataset id
entries.text: Where you set “Attach by dataset id”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Attach
entries.text: Shows “Attach”. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Datasets:
entries.text: Shows “Datasets:”. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Label (also the tooltip)
entries.text: Where you set “Label (also the tooltip)”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Icon
entries.text: Where you set “Icon”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Tone
entries.text: Where you set “Tone”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Small
entries.text: Shows the “Small” part of this screen. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Medium
entries.text: Shows the “Medium” part of this screen. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Sort by column id (empty = the dataset's first column)
entries.text: Where you set “Sort by column id (empty = the dataset's first column)”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Shown on the toolbar
entries.text: Turns “Shown on the toolbar” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Move left
entries.text: Moves left. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Move right
entries.text: Moves right. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Reset style
entries.text: Resets style. Your own changes go. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Add to the toolbar
entries.text: Adds to the toolbar. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Close the preview
entries.text: Closes the preview. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Show the toolbar on attached datasets
entries.text: Turns “Show the toolbar on attached datasets” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Center
entries.text: Shows the “Center” part of this screen. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Back to default
entries.text: Shows “Back to default”. Part of Basic filter.

entries.title: Kind
entries.text: The “Kind” column. Tap its header to sort the list by it.
